caption: The drawing consists of a decorative pattern featuring stylized floral and leaf motifs in red and green on a beige background. A single large central flower with six green leaves and four red petals is positioned in the middle. Around this central motif, there are four small green leaf clusters, each comprised of four leaves forming an 'X' shape, evenly spaced in a rectangular arrangement. Along the four edges, there is a border pattern formed by alternating green leaves and red buds running vertically along both the left and right edges. In each of the four corners outside this border, there is a symmetrical motif featuring two red and green flowers with green leaves spreading outward. Midway along each side, between the corners, there are circular arrangements of six green leaves and six red dots creating star-like shapes. The entire design is contained within a thin rectangular frame.
title: Wall Stencil (From an Inn)
